items.problem: UWP screen-capture protection (`ApplicationView.GetForCurrentView().IsScreenCaptureEnabled = false/true`) has no documented WinUI 3 mapping. The agent followed the windowing/GetForCurrentView guidance (ApplicationView → AppWindow), guessed `AppWindow.IsScreenCaptureEnabled`, and hit a build failure.
items.evidence: session-log.txt ~2243-2244: `error CS1061: 'AppWindow' does not contain a definition for 'IsScreenCaptureEnabled'`. Fixed at ~2302 by adding Win32 `SetWindowDisplayAffinity(hwnd, WDA_EXCLUDEFROMCAPTURE/WDA_NONE)`. Confirmed in the agent's own summary (~2950).
items.skill_search: Grepped winui-uwp-migration for `ScreenCapture|DisplayAffinity|WDA_|content protect|IsProtected` across SKILL.md, MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md, and scripts/*.json — 0 hits.
items.root_cause: The skill maps `ApplicationView.GetForCurrentView()` generically to `AppWindow.GetFromWindowId(...)` but never states that the screen-capture-protection capability is NOT an AppWindow member and requires a Win32 HWND call.
items.proposed_fix: Add a `` section to MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md documenting `SetWindowDisplayAffinity(hwnd, WDA_EXCLUDEFROMCAPTURE / WDA_NONE)` (with WDA constants and HWND-via-WindowNative), add a clarifying row to the GetForCurrentView/AppWindow tables, and add an `IsScreenCaptureEnabled` adaptable entry in unsupported-api-inventory.json routed to the `screen-capture` anchor (placed before the generic GetForCurrentView/ApplicationView patterns so the injected TODO points to the right section).
items.generalizes: Screen-capture prevention / content protection (privacy screens, DRM, secure fields) is a recurring UWP capability; any UWP app that sets IsScreenCaptureEnabled will hit the identical dead-end mapping to AppWindow. The Win32 SetWindowDisplayAffinity substitution is the standard, app-agnostic WinUI 3 desktop equivalent.
